name: lem-maincb-improvement-one-step
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-improvement-one-step — There are universal K_step >= 1 and e_step > 0 such that, if B is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, A an extended epsilon-C*-algebra, and v:B->A an extended d-inclusion with d+epsilon <= e_step, then one dagger-preserving level-one map v^+, with v_n^+ = I_n tensor v^+, satisfies sup_n ||v_n^+ - v_n|| <= K_step*d and is an extended d^+-inclusion for d^+ <= K_step*(d^2+epsilon).
